newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jiangsu Expressway to price at HK$3.11/shr-source.
newsitem.headline: Jiangsu Expressway to price at HK$3.11/shr-source.

text.p: Chinese toll road operator Jiangsu Expressway Co Ltd is expected to issue 1.22 billion new H-shares, or 25 percent of its enlarged share capital at HK$3.11 each, a source close to the deal said on Friday.
H-shares are shares of mainland Chinese state-owned enterprises listed in Hong Kong.
The price was fixed at the high side of a revised price range of between HK$2.90 to HK$3.18 per share, the source said.
Its previous price range stood between HK$2.62 and HK$3.04. About 90 percent of the issue is to be placed with institutional investors with the balance to be offered to the public in Hong Kong.
Its initial public offering in the territory is expected to run from June 18 to 23, with dealing in the company shares scheduled to begin on June 27, the source said.
